result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers correctly identify the tour as an interface inventory and redirect it toward guiding users to send a first invoice, naming specific steps to cut or defer. B also says its diagnosis is an inference from the tour text and suggests checking where step-1 skippers go next. It gives fuller replacement copy, including the opening prompt and a post-send confirmation that defers the bank connection. A presents its causes as fact, and its suggested check, about invited users, is more tangential. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers correctly see the tour as a list of interface features. Both refocus it on sending a first invoice by having the user do it, and both name specific steps to cut or defer. A is better on hedging: it says its diagnosis is inferred from the tour text and the 80% figure, and suggests checking where people who skip go next. B states its causes with more certainty, and its suggested check (comparing invited users) only partly tests the diagnosis.
